## What problem would this solve?

Describe the situation you run into, with a concrete example if you can ("my collection has 40 folders and I need to...").

## What would you like to happen?

What the program would do, in plain words. If it touches a screen, say which one.

## What you do today instead

Any workaround you use, or why none works.

## Anything else

For example: whether it concerns one classification engine, one document type, the Claude Project package, the Claude Code side, or a feature that would need the program to leave Windows (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for what is out of scope).
